nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Ultra-Thin Spot Cover Patch with Mirror

avis.texte: The cutest compact you could ever have. The patches are super adorable as well. I love having the cutest maknae on my face!

Got these for my 12-year-old daughter, and she loved them, especially the cute K-pop demon hunter prints! She had a couple of recurring breakouts that were noticeably smaller after day one and gone by day two after use.

I was so excited for these. I love the little compact that matches the one from the movie, and the designs of the patches are so cute. I used a couple on some small whiteheads, and when I removed them the next morning, taking them off hurt SO MUCH. It ripped off any peach fuzz I has on the spot, and left an angry red welt the shape of the patch. And to top it off, the whiteheads were still there! 3 days later and I still have sensitive Rumi-shaped red marks on my face. :( I'll still use these for bug bites on my arms and legs since they're so cute, but I am definitely never using them on my face again!
